title: A modified Riemannian Levenberg-Marquardt Algorithm for robust or constraint optimization on manifolds
summary: We extend the Levenberg-Marquardt method on Riemannian manifolds to a robust variant that allows to tackle problems from applications where outliers are to be expected. We formally state the framework for a block-wise variant of the Robust Riemannian Levenberg-Marquardt algorithm and discuss how known convergence results can be applied here as well. We further discuss several alternatives for phrasing the sub problem that has to be solved.
